about: The film profiles that ship with DarkSlide (github.com/kilianvivien/DarkSlide, MIT licence, (c) 2026 Kilian Vivien) as looks: contrast, saturation, temperature and tint carried over, its tonal character (shadow lift and highlight roll-off) as Lab Look's Fade and the Print Response Shoulder. Its exposure, colour balance, black and white points, highlight protection and colour matrices correct for DarkSlide's own inversion and are not carried over. See docs/presets.md.
